text: Can someone take care of this please?
I write to inquire about the matter previously discussed.
Following up.

I am following up on what we talked about the other day, or maybe it was the week before, anyway you know the thing I mean, and I just wanted to make sure it is moving along however it is supposed to.
Hello, I follow up about the thing from before. Please check. Thank you.
hey just checking in about that thing we discussed let me know whats happening
Nobody ever gets back to me about anything in this place. You know what this is about.
Dear Office, Further to our recent discussion, I await your response in due course. Respectfully.
Is this something you can handle? Thanks.
Please see below. Kindly advise accordingly.
See below. Please handle.

So my daughter was supposed to put the details in this message for me before she went to work but she had to leave early, so all I can tell you is it is the same thing from last time and I would like it sorted out the same way if possible.
Please see below. The same as before. Handle please.
quick one, same thing as my last message, do the usual please
This is my third message about this and every time I am told to send it again. Just look at my history, you will see what I mean.
Dear Office, I refer to my earlier correspondence, which appears to have gone unaddressed. Kindly advise. Respectfully.
You know what to do.
I would be obliged if the office would attend to the outstanding matter at its convenience.
Checking in again on my thing. Let me know.

My son usually handles all of this online stuff for me and he is away on business, so I am writing even though I am not entirely sure what to ask for, only that something was supposed to happen by now and it has not.
Please check my file and do what is needed. I come back later. Thank you.
just still waiting on that thing from last time let me know when its done
I called, I wrote, I called again. Nothing. Do what needs doing.
Dear Sir or Madam, The matter remains outstanding. I should be grateful for your attention. Respectfully.
Just bumping this up in case it got lost.
Kindly treat this message as a reminder concerning the pending matter.
Reminder. The pending matter.

Time keeps going by and whatever was supposed to be arranged still has not been, and honestly at my age I cannot keep track of which office handles what, so I am sending this to you in the hopes you can point it in the right direction.
Still nothing happen from last message. Please do the needful.
bumping my last message in case it got buried whatever we talked about still needs doing
